status: POST-HOC deviation, written after Test 2-3 and Test 7 results were seen. The registered reports (report_T2T3.txt, report_T7.txt) remain the primary results; A1 results are reported alongside and labelled as a deviation.
problem: The registered readout is ridge with no intercept. QR readout features have a non-zero mean that acts as an intercept; RandTrig and RFF features are close to zero-mean and cannot fit the level of the target. On Test 7 their median test MSE was 2-3x HAR. Diagnostic on HG, NG, GC (QR1 size, 30 instances): adding a constant column cut median test MSE by 40-55%; raising lambda to 1e-2 changed nothing.
change: RandTrig-p and RFF-p are rebuilt as p-1 random features plus one constant column (still p readout columns, still size-matched). Seeds, the 100-instance validation selection, the RFF bandwidth grid {0.3, 1, 3} and the readout (lambda 1e-8, no further intercept) are unchanged. ESN, ESNtuned, Trig2 (already has a constant column), QR_J0, AR3 and HAR are unchanged.
scoring: Same scripts and rules as registered, run with the 'fix' argument: t2t3_report.py fix > report_T2T3_A1.txt, t7_report.py fix > report_T7_A1.txt.
